desc: Derive/verify the gap transformation: for gaps d_j = X_{j+1}-X_j, operation at i swaps d_i and d_{i+2} and leaves d_{i+1}; note parity independence and arbitrary permutation via adjacent swaps.
Implement input reading and compute gaps from the sorted input coordinates.
Partition gaps into two lists by 1-indexed parity (or 0-based even/odd), and sort each list ascending.
Reconstruct the minimum weighted sum: start with N*X_1, then for each gap position j=1..N-1 take the next gap from the corresponding sorted parity list and add (N-j)*gap.
Use Python integer arithmetic, print the answer, and test mentally on samples and edge cases such as N=4 and already sorted gaps.
